_about: ADR-0099: the one source for Settings -> Legal and Settings -> Credits, and for THIRD-PARTY.md. Every component the image ships, fetches, lets the user install, or was reimplemented from has an entry; core/tests/test_notices.py fails the build when one is missing. The prose is a draft until George approves it; it is not legal advice.

sections.heading: Gexis Player
paragraphs: Gexis Player is free software: you can redistribute it and modify it under the terms of the GNU General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any later version, as published by the Free Software Foundation. Its source is at github.com/gcarstoiu/gexis-player.

It is distributed in the hope that it will be useful, but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the GNU General Public License for details. You use it at your own risk, including any risk to your equipment and your hearing.

sections.heading: What it is built from
paragraphs: The player is assembled from other people's work, each under its own licence. Each is listed below with its licence and where it comes from. Where a licence asks for its notice to be kept, it is kept in the component's own files on the device.

sections.heading: Proprietary software
paragraphs: Plexamp is Plex's own software, not free software. It is downloaded from Plex when the image is built, is included in it, and is used under Plex's terms, not under the player's licence.

sections.heading: Unofficial clients
paragraphs: Qobuz Connect is not part of the player. If you choose to install it, Settings downloads Pibuz, an independent open-source receiver, from its author's own release. Pibuz is not made, affiliated with, endorsed or certified by Qobuz. It may stop working at any time. Using it may not be permitted by Qobuz's terms of service. You install and use it at your own risk and on your own Qobuz account. Uninstalling it removes it from the device.

sections.heading: Services the player contacts
paragraphs: To show pictures, weather and information about what you play, the player asks the services below. It sends only what each request needs, such as an artist's name or your approximate location for the weather. It sends no account details of yours to any of them.

sections.heading: Trademarks
paragraphs: Names and logos such as Spotify, Qobuz, Plex and Plexamp, Bluetooth, Lyrion, Raspberry Pi and HiFiBerry are trademarks of their owners. They are used here only to name the service or product they belong to. Their use does not mean that any of their owners endorses this player, or is affiliated with it.
Gexis Player stands on the work of many people who gave it away. Thank you.
